caption: The drawing depicts a single object, a teapot, positioned centrally on an off-white or light beige background. The teapot is rendered in gray pencil tones, suggesting a metallic surface, likely silver. The teapot has a rounded body with a slight narrowing at the top where it meets the lid. The lid is domed, with decorative fluting and an ornate finial at the apex. The spout is long, thin, and curves upward from the left side of the teapot. On the right side, there is a large, curved handle, shaded darker to indicate a different material, possibly wood or ebonized to contrast with the metallic body. The body of the teapot bears an engraved or embossed monogram composed of intertwining letters. There are subtle highlights and shading on the teapot, giving it a three-dimensional and reflective appearance. The composition is centered, and there are no other objects, textures, or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Silver Teapot
